payload.summary: Safety Plan: a half-written plan is lost without warning on tab close, refresh or phone swipe-back
payload.detail: The plan is deliberately browser-tab only and never persisted (src/components/patient-safety-plan.tsx:545 isDirty). isDirty guards only the in-app header back control; there is no beforeunload guard anywhere in the Safety Plan route, so closing the tab, reloading, or an OS back gesture discards an in-progress plan silently, potentially mid-consultation. Next action: add a beforeunload warning while isDirty is true, copying the existing pattern in src/components/cme/cme-entry-form.tsx:324, plus a unit or Playwright assertion that the listener is registered only while dirty. Must not persist plan content anywhere (privacy contract, see archived #060).
